caseNameFull: Alexander, Director, Alabama Department of Public Safety v. Sandoval, Individually and on Behalf of All Others Similarly Situated

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, November 13, 2000. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, December 13, 2000. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, December 29, 2000. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
